To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the 0 + and 2 + states of 8Be are well reproduced as gas-like deformed α-cluster states.
the rotational band states of the α-cluster condensed state of 8 Be can be reproduced by the introduction of the spatial deformation into the α-cluster condensation model wave function.
the 8 Be nucleus is a good example of the gas-like α-cluster condensations, and that the rotational band states of the α-cluster gas can be described well by a simple model.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the α-cluster structure in the self-conjuate 4n nuclei.
the investigation of the deformation of 8 Be as deformed gas-like two-α-particle states.
the study of the rotational band structure of 8 Be as deformed gas-like 2α-cluster states.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the 0 + and 2 + states of 8Be can be described as a weakly bound 2α-cluster gas with a spatial deformation.
the 0 + and 2 + states of 8Be can be well described as deformed gas-like 2α-cluster states.
the ground state of 8 Be can be considered to be a gas-like 2α-cluster system.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the 0 + and the 2 + states of 8Be can be considered as the ground and the first excited states, respectively, of a deformed α-cluster gas.
the 2α-cluster condensation is a robust phenomenon, and that the deformation of the condensate can be introduced in a simple manner.
the 8 Be ground state and the 2 + excited state have the same 2α-cluster configuration.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the α-cluster condensation is not necessarily destroyed by introducing deformation.
the deformation of the 0 α cluster condensate is not very effective in producing the rotational band states in the 4n nuclei.

, even though the deformation is introduced, the wave function of the deformed gas-like 2α cluster states is still almost the same as that of the non-deformed gas-like 0 + state, i.e. the wave function is dominated by the Brink's wave function, which is a simple linear combination of the 2α cluster wave functions.
